findings.title: Recheck the full T6 lease after later coordination lock waits
findings.description: The full commit adapter checks require_current_fence at protocol_execution.py:319 before acquiring S38, the receipt and S29/S37. That query checks lease_expires_at against clock_timestamp, but records only a cached LIVE tuple. idempotent_outcome checks that cached tuple at transactions.py:5561 and then can wait on planning_attempts or validation_results at :5571. The new _prepare_full_execution reads a fresh post-lock timestamp at :4200, but uses it only for immutable source/certificate reconstruction; it never rereads or compares the current lease expiry. prepare_authorization_basis checks a fresh root deadline and dependency validity, but contains no lease expiry predicate. With a valid full source chain and deadline, a bounded S29 lock wait can therefore cross the lease expiry and still issue both authorizations, switch the head and mark the root/attempt successful. Holding S01/S27 prevents concurrent mutation, but cannot prevent time from expiring a lease. This violates Protocol 5.3/6.5 and the packet's full_bundle_commit_dc oracle requiring the current lease to be rechecked at the final guarded operation.
findings.required_change: Revalidate the exact current owner/fence/request/attempt/live-root/unexpired-lease/deadline using fresh trusted post-lock time after the later aggregate locks and before full T6 mutation. Preserve the frozen lock order and legacy contract. Add an own-namespace real PostgreSQL case with owner-produced full COMMIT_READY inputs, a lease valid before an observed S29/S37 wait, expiry crossed during that bounded wait while source/deadline bounds remain live, and an explicit lease rejection plus complete zero-effect snapshot including first-use placeholders. Execute all required checks on the new implementation SHA and obtain fresh reviews.
findings.test_gap: The existing lease denial mutates expiry to an already elapsed value before invoking commit, so it only exercises the earlier fence check. The post-lock T6 expiry test crosses admission_seconds=8, not lease expiry; its committed witness identifies an expired resolution with lease_seconds=600. Thus successful raw commands do not establish the missing lease oracle.
